title: fix(i18n): separate the verb from the app name in the zh build header
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbXvWtxSR1T4kCqZYPovXw9C)_

Fixes #26643

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:中文界面下聊天机器人构建面板的标题,动词和应用名之间加了分隔符:完成时显示「已构建 · CRM」,进行中显示「正在构建 · CRM…」。以前是「已构建CRM」「正在构建CRM…」,应用名直接粘在动词上。
- **为什么改**:应用名是英文时尤其难读(「已构建Library Lending Management」)。分隔符沿用同组已有的「已搭建并上线 · 应用名」。
- **风险与回滚**:极低。只改 zh 语言包里两个值,不增删任何键;日文、韩文本来就没有这个问题,保持不变,其它拉丁语系语言包不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` 的 `chatbot.build.building` / `built` 两行;`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/buildPanelI18n-7388.test.tsx` 改过的三个 zh 断言和新增的 ja/ko 用例。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/buildPanelI18n-7388.test.tsx`,预期 14 个用例全绿;或在中文控制台让聊天机器人构建一个应用,标题显示「已构建 · 应用名」。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

In the zh pack, the chatbot build panel header composed the verb and the app name with nothing between them, so the name ran on into the verb (「已构建Library Lending Management」). Both header frames now use the ` · ` separator that the sibling `chatbot.build.builtAndLive` (「已搭建并上线 · APP」) already used:

| key (zh) | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `chatbot.build.built` | `已构建APP` | `已构建 · APP` |
| `chatbot.build.building` | `正在构建APP…` | `正在构建 · APP…` |

(`APP` stands for the interpolated app name.) `building` is in this PR by the seat's ruling: the same defect, in the same pack and the same test.

Values only: no key is added, removed or renamed. The other CJK packs did not run on and are unchanged: ja puts the name first and a particle after it (`APPを構築しました`), ko already leaves a space (`APP 빌드 완료`). The Latin-script packs are untouched.

## Why

The chatbot build panel header is the first thing a zh user reads when a build finishes, and a Latin-script app name glued to the verb reads as one word.

## Tests

- `buildPanelI18n-7388.test.tsx`: the three zh header pins move to the separated form (`正在构建 · CRM…`, `已构建 · CRM`, and the unnamed-build `正在构建 · 你的应用…`). A new describe pins the ja and ko headers as they are, for both the in-flight and the finished frame, so a later change to either pack has to say so.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): with the fix committed, `zh.ts` was restored to its `main` blob (old value count 1, new value count 0), `@object-ui/i18n` rebuilt, and the test file ran red: Tests 3 failed, 11 passed (the three zh header cases). Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, 14 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The unnamed-build fallback.** `chatbot.build.appFallback` (`你的应用`) is not a separate frame: the component substitutes it into the same `building` / `built` template. So an unnamed build now reads 「正在构建 · 你的应用…」. Making it read without the separator would need a new key or a component change, both outside this card. The separated form matches what `builtAndLive` already renders for an unnamed build (「已搭建并上线 · 你的应用」), so the three frames now read alike.
- Nothing else in the repository pins the old zh strings (`git grep` for `已构建` and `正在构建` finds only the pack and this test).
